decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds on the established and well-liked BASIC 518 trommel and was publicly rebranded, so the firm's investment and visible commitment remain high, and dropping it would contradict an earlier decision it has to justify.

The mobile high-speed grinder line is a multi-model investment that fits the firm's announced focus on mobile processing, so management would likely attribute weak results to the pandemic years rather than withdraw it, although its low web visibility leaves some risk of a cut.

The green-waste grinder line serves the core composting and biomass customers and involved several models, so management would persist with it despite its limited visibility and the 2019 pruning of other lines.
